description: This dataset contains 20 occurrence records of the plant Oenothera coronopifolia observed in the United States, primarily in Utah, Colorado, New Mexico and Wyoming. Each entry provides a unique GBIF occurrence identifier, dataset and occurrence URLs, and a full taxonomic hierarchy from kingdom to species. Precise geolocation is included, with latitudes from 36.78 to 41.22 degrees north and longitudes from ‑112.54 to ‑103.91 degrees east, together with coordinate‑uncertainty values up to 28 121 m. Temporal fields record event dates (2012‑2025) and identification timestamps, while licensing is CC‑BY‑NC‑4.0 or CC0 and media are still images. The semantic profile links biodiversity identifiers, spatial coordinates, timestamps and attribution fields, making the data suitable for distribution modelling, phenology analysis, taxonomic verification and conservation planning of Oenothera coronopifolia.
